title: Figure 25: Monthly Distribution of Aircraft-Evaluated vs. All Other Object Sightings
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing the monthly distribution, January through December, of "Total Less Aircraft" object sightings (left) with sightings evaluated as "Aircraft" (right), both in percent from 0 to 40. July has the longest bars on both sides, followed by August. Caption: "FIGURE 25 COMPARISON OF MONTHLY DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS EVALUATED AS AIRCRAFT VERSUS TOTAL OBJECT SIGHTINGS LESS AIRCRAFT"; drawing A-7503.
